title: Monarch CLI mutation outcome (v1)
description: Normative contract for the mutation-outcome.v1 envelope emitted on stdout after every remote mutation is attempted. One envelope covers atomic, batch, and multi-stage operations; multi-stage workflows use one ordered item per attempted or observable remote effect and never add command-specific top-level fields. Dry-run previews (status: dry_run) are deliberately NOT part of this schema family. Cross-field arithmetic invariants (summary.total == len(items) and the per-status counts matching items) cannot be expressed in JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 and are enforced by the CLI contract validator used in tests. Additive-only for optional properties; removing or changing required fields, status values, or their semantics requires mutation-outcome.v2.

operation.description: Stable namespaced operation identifier (for example transactions.attachments.add). Never inferred from an upstream method or GraphQL name.

summary.description: Per-status counts. Counts must match items and total must equal len(items); that arithmetic invariant is enforced by the contract validator.

items.description: Ordered item outcomes. Atomic operations use exactly one item; batches preserve normalized input order; multi-stage workflows preserve remote-effect order.

verification.description: Follow-up verification guidance; null when no item is ambiguous.

code.description: Stable error code. Open set; MUTATION_AMBIGUOUS is reserved for ambiguous items.

message.description: Sanitized, actionable message; never raw upstream exception text.

entity.description: Stable effect-specific entity identifier (for example transaction, attachment_media, attachment).

id.description: Best available remote identity for the effect.

result.description: Normalized JSON object on success; null otherwise.

error.description: Null on success; the stable error object otherwise.

required.description: Always true: an ambiguous outcome requires follow-up verification.

message.description: Actionable guidance for confirming remote state safely.

command.description: Tokenized safe read-only verification command when the CLI can provide one.
